source_audit.ot_check: All eight final pages show regulation 4Q score and FINAL rather than FINAL/OT. 0 overtimes, team-local 2026-11-16.

full_game_ou.reason: Pregame named-book quotes/odds were candidate research receipts, no independently verified and pretip locked O/U direction. No retrospective market reconstruction.

analyst_winner.pregame_rationale: Orlando 12 accepted games ORtg 106.78 meets Boston 13 games DRtg 103.59; Celtics ORtg 116.78 also materially exceeds Magic DRtg 111.00. Paolo Banchero OUT makes Orlando's offensive self-creation a genuine pretip risk.
analyst_winner.pregame_counterargument: Boston Neemias Queta QUESTIONABLE; Orlando still has Franz Wagner and Desmond Bane creation. Potential replacement minutes not independently validated and 12-13 GP is early-season sampling.

analyst_winner.pregame_rationale: Cleveland 14 GP ORtg 114.80 faces Chicago 12 GP DRtg 117.63 and the Bulls' fast 107.31 possessions average; Cleveland two-way team ratings are stronger than Chicago's 107.00 ORtg. Home court supports the frozen favorite.
analyst_winner.pregame_counterargument: Evan Mobley confirmed OUT, both Jaylon Tyson and Peyton Watson QUESTIONABLE. Bulls unexpectedly beat Minnesota on Nov15, but that single result is not a new calibrated strength claim; high 3PA volatility is relevant.

analyst_winner.pregame_rationale: Memphis 13 GP ORtg 116.90/DRtg 108.26 versus Washington 13 GP ORtg 108.09/DRtg 117.02 makes a substantial two-sided matchup. Washington's defense is the primary vulnerability.
analyst_winner.pregame_counterargument: Memphis absences include Ty Jerome, Scotty Pippen Jr, GG Jackson and Isaiah Stewart OUT in the newer report; Zach Edey was QUESTIONABLE in the morning report. No verified replacement-minute model, and Washington may exploit Memphis guard/frontcourt depth.

analyst_winner.pregame_rationale: Philadelphia 14 GP DRtg 108.54 beats Brooklyn 12 GP DRtg 113.18 and PHI offense 110.54 beats Brooklyn 107.17; model sees PHI ~66.59% favorite.
analyst_winner.pregame_counterargument: Philadelphia LeBron James definitively OUT, Joel Embiid QUESTIONABLE, and they played Indiana on Sunday (back-to-back). Crucial offensive/rebounding creation role and minute replacement unverified; the evidence does not independently establish a directional winner, so analyst abstains.

analyst_winner.pregame_rationale: Houston's 14 GP ORtg 118.58 and DRtg 108.41 versus Miami 13 GP ORtg 112.73 and DRtg 113.71 support the frozen away favorite at 64.03%.
analyst_winner.pregame_counterargument: Houston played Washington Sunday and is on second night of a back-to-back; Steven Adams, Clint Capela and Marcus Smart are OUT, Amen Thompson QUESTIONABLE. Miami with Bam Adebayo/Giannis Antetokounmpo has plausible frontcourt mismatch and longer rest; role-based evidence insufficient to select a confident side.

analyst_winner.pregame_rationale: Frozen season sample favors Golden State 68.20%, as Warriors DRtg 110.17 compares to Pelicans 118.41 and Warriors ORtg 114.57 versus New Orleans 109.30.
analyst_winner.pregame_counterargument: Stephen Curry, Jimmy Butler III, Moses Moody and Kristaps Porzingis OUT for GSW; Trey Murphy III and Dejounte Murray OUT for NOP. Warriors offensive role substitution and Pelicans' available Zion Williamson/Derik Queen/Jeremiah Fears make the net impact ambiguous. No robust player-minute replacement exposure was verified.

analyst_winner.pregame_rationale: Minnesota 13 GP DRtg 102.58 is significantly better than Portland 12 GP DRtg 109.17; Wolves' home court and defense sustain the narrow 65.42% baseline.
analyst_winner.pregame_counterargument: Anthony Edwards and Donte DiVincenzo are confirmed OUT, while Portland misses Ja Morant and Shaedon Sharpe (both confirmed OUT). Minnesota lost unexpectedly to Chicago; however that's one realized outcome not a proven persistent issue. The uncertain replacements weaken analyst confidence.

analyst_winner.pregame_rationale: Denver's 11 GP ORtg 114.18 is competitive against Phoenix's 12 GP DRtg 115.36 and Nuggets are home. Phoenix lost to Lakers on Sunday and plays second game of a back-to-back; Denver's official pretip team note reports winning their earlier meeting 127-120.
analyst_winner.pregame_counterargument: Denver 11 GP defense is DRtg 112.59 (not elite), Phoenix has perimeter shot variance, and Suns official game-specific report was not yet submitted in morning edition. Mark Williams is reported OUT by dated independent injury source; his current status should not be assigned as official until reported.

selective_research.pregame_known: GSW model 68.20% favorite, Curry/Butler/Moody/Porzingis OUT. Analyst deliberately ABSTAIN because star and creator replacement minutes not verified; NOP also missing Murphy/Murray.
selective_research.postgame_observed: GSW lost 94-115; first quarter 11-35. Warriors shot 11/46 3P (23.9%); New Orleans Fears triple-double, Bey 23 points. Total 209 vs model 236.86; home margin +21 vs model -5.93.
selective_research.competing_explanations: Availability-mediated shot creation, opponent execution, shooting variance and rotations are plausible; their separate causal effects cannot be established from one game.

selective_research.pregame_known: BOS model favorite 83.26%, analyst BOS MEDIUM, Magic Banchero OUT; analyst noted Wagner/Bane capable of creating offense. Boston had played Dallas on Nov15 but back-to-back impact not explicitly made central in locked lean.
selective_research.postgame_observed: Orlando won 115-105; scored 40 points in Q4, including Bane 15 Q4 points; 54-32 points in paint, 20-7 fastbreak; Boston first home loss.
selective_research.competing_explanations: Magic paint drives, Boston back-to-back, missing Banchero despite stronger replacements, shooting/game-state variance. Can describe observed differences but cannot isolate pretip predictive value without larger as-of sample.

selective_research.pregame_known: DEN model 68.83%, analyst DEN MEDIUM; Phoenix on back-to-back from Lakers loss, Denver home. Analyst countercase mentioned Phoenix perimeter shooting and non-elite Denver defense.
selective_research.postgame_observed: Phoenix won 117-105, +12 away; Phoenix rebounds 60-42, second-chance points 22-11, Suns bench 42-19; Denver 17 turnovers. Large realized rebounding advantage contradicted simplistic expected fatigue mechanism.
selective_research.competing_explanations: Rebounding, rotation depth, shooting and possessions. Rebound edge was not established as a pretip expectation; avoid treating as predictable due hindsight.

selective_research.pregame_known: PHI model 66.59%, analyst ABSTAIN due LeBron OUT, Joel Embiid QUESTIONABLE and PHI back-to-back. No pretip certainty on final lineup or replacement minutes.
selective_research.postgame_observed: Philadelphia won 135-123. Joel Embiid scored 37 and Jaylen Brown scored 31. Model total 224.23 vs 258 actual (33.77 error), largest total miss.
selective_research.competing_explanations: Embiid playing rather than missing, realized scoring efficiencies and matchup. Q was not OUT at prediction time. Do not declare abstention wrong because model winner was correct.

audit_notes: Pregame lock read before searching 2026-11-16 game outcomes; all game-forecast timestamps are before respective tipoffs.
Model C parameters and probability/total/margin outputs reproduced exactly from the original pretip lock; no postgame refit and no retroactively invented picks.
Official pretip O/U grade N/A, as no analyst-reviewed market selections with verified bookmaker main line were locked. Indexed candidate quotes not used to reconstruct bets.
Analyst winner performance 3/5 (MEDIUM 2/4, LOW 1/1), not 4/5; original 3 abstentions preserved. No contrarian selection, so incremental value cannot be directly estimated.
Pregame missing players and statuses are preserved as originally recorded; no hindsight rewriting Q into OUT or active without fresh evidence.
One night is insufficient for permanent model blind-spot or excess confidence diagnosis; the source evidence and alternative mechanisms are tracked as hypotheses.
